note: Proposal for O14 (DEC-O14: conservative default, no indefinite lock, not applied before the owner approves). Every period is unset (null): DEC-O14 gives no value for N and none is invented here. Applying a rule needs max_age_days set for every rule, an approval record, and status approved/applied; `python3 -I tools/r2_budget.py lock-rules` checks that (no request).
release_authority: Admin-permission token or the dashboard account only. Collection, verification and ledger tokens never get Admin permission (infra/r2/README.md section 3).

rules.why: Originals may not be obtainable again (dynamic HTML, withdrawn disclosures).
Observation history shows which bytes were seen when.
Deleting the last record is not detected by the tool (BUDGET.md section 5); audit recomputes checkpoints from these records.
A deleted newest checkpoint falls back to an older one plus records; a replaced one is caught by audit only while the raw records exist.
Admissions count against the caps; deleting them lowers the counted usage.
A closure marker stops a month's runs; deleting it reopens the month early.

derived_bucket.note: 미정 — DEC-O14 does not choose between 'not locked' and 'locked only briefly'; derived data can be rebuilt from the originals.

wrong_upload_procedure: 미정 — 적용 전에 정해야 함 (DEC-O14). Until then: verify-copy reports keys outside the pinned list and exits 1; nothing is deleted by this tool.
